verdict.rationale: Groq is an LLM inference API. The only rule-on-event automation in the evidence is billing spend limits, which apply automated caps and send budget alerts when thresholds are reached. Tool use and remote MCP are model-driven actions inside a request, not user-defined event rules, so they do not count here. Missing for 10: general user-defined event→action rules, webhooks or event triggers (e.g., on batch completion), automation documentation beyond billing, and independent corroboration.
